about:
A1 Graphic & Lettering operates from a 2,500-square-foot facility on the outskirts of Georgetown, Delaware. The company was founded in 2010 by Vic Thomas, who serves as owner and graphic designer, and Sharon Thomas, who oversees embroidery. From the start it has been run as a family-owned, mom-and-pop operation serving the local community and shipping nationwide.

The shop provides custom T-shirt printing, embroidery, sign manufacturing, and direct-to-film (DTF) gang sheets. Vic Thomas handles graphic design in-house, while Sharon Thomas manages the embroidery workflow. The facility supports both small-run and larger orders, with the company noting it has fulfilled uniform packages for youth leagues and embroidered polos for area businesses.

Customers come from youth sports organizations, restaurants, corporate clients, and vehicle owners. A local little league sourced its uniforms through the shop; J & B Grilling ordered branded apparel; a business client needed dry-fit polos with logo embroidery; and another customer had truck graphics produced. The business ships across the country and emphasizes competitive shipping rates.

The founders say they differentiate through a commitment to perfection on every job, visually dynamic original designs, and a hands-on approach that includes design tweaks to optimize results. They highlight 15-plus years of experience, in-house design capability, and a 20-business-day delivery window as core to their service promise.
